exposure: Straining during delivery for more than 20 minutes
finding: Constipation, personal history of peri-anal diseases, straining during delivery for more than 20 minutes, and newborn birth weight >3800g were independently associated with an increased risk of developing hemorrhoids and anal fissures during pregnancy and postpartum.
mod_finding: Straining during delivery for more than 20 minutes was associated with an increased risk of haemorrhoids and anal fissures.
